curriculum: University of Dhaka B.S. Honours Statistics 2023–24

sources.institution: University of Dhaka, Department of Statistics
sources.role: Syllabus foundation for B.S. Honours in Statistics (Course Stat H-309 Research Methodology & Stat H-413 Research Project)

sources.institution: Pearl, J. (2009). Causality: Models, Reasoning, and Inference (2nd ed.)
sources.role: Definitive mathematical formulation of Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs), d-separation, backdoor criterion, and structural causal models

sources.institution: Groves, R.M., Fowler, F.J., Couper, M.P., Lepkowski, J.M., Singer, E., & Tourangeau, R. (2009). Survey Methodology (2nd ed.)
sources.role: Authoritative treatise on Total Survey Error (TSE), questionnaire design, nonresponse adjustment, and cognitive response models

sources.institution: Cohen, J. (1988). Statistical Power Analysis for the Behavioral Sciences (2nd ed.)
sources.role: Foundational text on effect size indices (d, r, f^2, w), non-central distributions, and analytical sample size determination

sources.institution: Angrist, J.D., & Pischke, J.-S. (2009). Mostly Harmless Econometrics: An Empiricist's Companion
sources.role: Rigorous treatment of instrumental variables (2SLS), regression discontinuity designs (RDD), and difference-in-differences (DiD)
